title: Back-to-back on tired legs, rolling, D+ capped 400m
terrain: valley / rolling forest, D+ and D- both under 400m

steps.target: Z2 rolling, 80-88% LTHR, run every climb

coachNotes: The back-to-back survives, the vertical does not. Two consecutive days of aerobic work on legs that are not fresh is most of what the original weekend was buying; the 1100m of extra descent is what we cannot safely take after a 17-day descent gap plus rain. Sunday now has the better forecast of the two weekend days (23C, rain easing, storm risk decreasing), so this is the day the pre-authorised Saturday/Sunday swap is most likely to fire. If it does, this day takes Saturday's double climb at load 140 and Saturday takes this rolling 80. Either way the D+ ceiling for the weekend as a whole does not move. In its unswapped form: last day in the Alps, so if a genuine dry window opens you may take up to 400m D+ on a non-technical line, no more. Bike substitution allowed one for one if it is raining hard: 90m endurance spin plus 20m flat jog. Garmin expect 130-160.
